response.sql: WITH rental_totals AS (SELECT i.store_id, r.rental_id, SUM(p.amount) AS payment_total FROM rental AS r JOIN inventory AS i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id JOIN payment AS p ON p.rental_id = r.rental_id GROUP BY i.store_id, r.rental_id), store_averages AS (SELECT store_id, rental_id, payment_total, AVG(payment_total) OVER (PARTITION BY store_id) AS average_payment_total FROM rental_totals) SELECT store_id, SUM(payment_total) AS combined_payment_total, AVG(payment_total - average_payment_total) AS average_amount_above_average FROM store_averages WHERE payment_total > average_payment_total GROUP BY store_id ORDER BY store_id
